g.text: Event002 cure panel, shared 46% production crop
Inspect measures the shared body text at 346×96, so it exceeds the body by 4px.
Accepted body: x=104, y=34, width=352, maxHeight=96
The body ends at y=130. The panel ends at y=136 with 6px below it.
Keep the 470px panel width and all icon, header, font, and x/y positions.
Use concise research labels: “Shared research. Members combine their findings.”
Use “Advanced strains take longer to research.” as the final body sentence.
Keep the existing 120-day shared and 360-day local activation lines.
Production crop source: pre_shared46_full.png, 1920×1080, UI scale 1.
